name: Shackleton Crater rim
blurb: Permanently shadowed crater at the lunar south pole, a leading candidate for ice and a base location.
source: Slope/roughness: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1), 5x5 grid at 500 m on the rim crest. Temperature range: rough team estimate, not sourced. Basaltic: estimate.

name: Malapert Massif
blurb: High, often-illuminated massif near the south pole with Earth line-of-sight, considered for a base.
source: Slope/roughness: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1), 5x5 grid at 500 m at the summit area. Temperature range: rough team estimate, not sourced. Basaltic: estimate.

name: Jezero Crater
blurb: Ancient lake basin with a river delta, landing site of Perseverance.
source: Temperature range: derived from July-Aug 2021 daily curves (about 200-260 K), arXiv:2204.12850. Slope/roughness/basaltic: team estimates, not measured.

name: Gale Crater
blurb: Impact crater with a central mound of layered sediments, explored by Curiosity.
source: Temperature range: derived from July-Aug 2021 daily curves (about 190-250 K), arXiv:2204.12850. Slope/roughness/basaltic: team estimates, not measured.
